description: This header file declares APIs and data structures for managing user interface and remote access settings in a Data Model library, including functions for getting/setting parameters, validation, commit, and rollback operations.
external_methods: COSA APIs for handling parameters and Data Model objects

methods.name: UserInterface_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value for the UserInterface object.

methods.name: UserInterface_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter value for the UserInterface object.

methods.name: UserInterface_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves an unsigned long parameter value for the UserInterface object.

methods.name: UserInterface_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets an unsigned long parameter value for the UserInterface object.

methods.name: UserInterface_Validate
methods.description: Validates the UserInterface parameters before commit.

methods.name: UserInterface_Commit
methods.description: Commits changes made to the UserInterface object.

methods.name: RemoteAccess_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value for the RemoteAccess object.

methods.name: RemoteAccess_GetParamIntValue
methods.description: Retrieves an integer parameter value for the RemoteAccess object.

methods.name: RemoteAccess_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves an unsigned long parameter value for the RemoteAccess object.

methods.name: RemoteAccess_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value for the RemoteAccess object.

methods.name: RemoteAccess_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter value for the RemoteAccess object.

methods.name: RemoteAccess_SetParamIntValue
methods.description: Sets an integer parameter value for the RemoteAccess object.

methods.name: RemoteAccess_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets an unsigned long parameter value for the RemoteAccess object.

methods.name: RemoteAccess_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets a string parameter value for the RemoteAccess object.

methods.name: RemoteAccess_Validate
methods.description: Validates the RemoteAccess parameters before commit.

methods.name: RemoteAccess_Commit
methods.description: Commits changes made to the RemoteAccess object.

methods.name: RemoteAccess_Rollback
methods.description: Reverts uncommitted changes for the RemoteAccess object.
